title: #3251's CI debt step does not run hooks/test_guard.py a second time beside the checks-guard shards
why: Finding (the #3251 lane via the coordinator 21:20 CST Nov 14; the coordinator did not read it, triage read no code or workflow; n=1): #3251's CI debt step runs test_guard.py inside the checks job beside the checks-guard shards, so CI runs the suite twice for the same tree. Harm: a repeat run for the same change, which the owner's 20:17 goal (ruling own-goal-max-efficiency-accurate-fast) calls waste; rule roles-each-layer-proves-once. Fix (the lane's, two ways): the step reads the shard jobs' result through `needs`, or the Retire line names the shard. First act of a lane: read the workflow where the debt step runs and the checks-guard shards, confirm the duplicate (count the extra minutes from a run, else unmeasured), then pick the fix with a Departs from line; a change that moves a refusal to a pass on weaker evidence is a widening and goes to the coordinator first. Red then green. Start it after #3251 merges. Kin: debt-close-reads-ci (the local `--ready` run of the same suite), retire-check-whole-suite (doing), lane-lint-runs-all-suite-jobs (ready; the lint side of the same checks jobs). ALIAS 21:56 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 21:55, from the debt-close-reads-ci lane; triage read nothing): the lane's own name for this step is debt-retire-reads-shard-jobs, the same finding (CI's Debt retire check step runs hooks/test_guard.py inside the checks job beside the checks-guard shards, so CI runs that suite twice; fix: read the shard jobs' result via needs, or have the Retire name the shard). One record per question: no second step. Status ready, no lane yet; start after #3251 merges (coordinator 21:20 note) or at once as the coordinator chooses. OWNER QUESTION 23:42 CST Nov 14 (lane session_013NEJL27N29gMxcUwtwKHXW, read of the workflow; triage read no workflow code): the `needs` fix is a widening. (1) When scope flag checks_guard is false, every shard step is skipped but the job result is still success, so a debt close would pass with no test run. (2) On a PR event the shards check out the merge commit; the debt step runs $HEAD_SHA, a different tree. (3) `checks` would wait about 16 min for the shards vs about 15 min today. The duplicate runs only on a PR that closes a debt whose Retire line names hooks/test_guard.py: 11 of 151 debts; run 43678092611 closed none (0 extra min); extra minutes per affected PR unmeasured (only figure: a pre-split workflow comment, median 21.1 min). Options: 1 skip only when the shards ran this tree (read shard result and scope flag; run as now otherwise), the lane's pick; 2 Retire line names the shard (widening; changes decision debt-close-runs-retire); 3 leave it. Posted as page item 852 (pick-debt-step-skip-guard-rerun); lane builds nothing until answered. No past owner ruling found. OWNER SAVED 00:09 CST Nov 15 (page item 852): "2 (B or A are good since botj avoid repeat run, ask consultant)". The word was unclear between options 1 and 2 (he calls both fine because both avoid the repeat run) and he said to ask the consultant. ANSWERED 00:16 CST Nov 15: the consultant picked option 1 (skip only when the shards ran on this tree; reads the shard result and the scope flag; runs as now when the flag is false or the tree differs), its reading under the owner's 20:18 words, not owner-typed; ruling own-852-1; item 852 closed. The lane may build option 1 (triage tells it). Option 2 is not covered, and neither is a change to decision debt-close-runs-retire.
